messages:
sara.h: Heads-up — kicking off a blue/green traffic swap for router-service (v2.4.9 -> v2.5.0) in eu-west tonight 23:00–01:00 UTC. Plan: 5-step ramp (5/10/25/50/100). release notes: https://redwood.internal/rel/RS-189

deploy-bot: Rollout started by sara.h: router-service v2.5.0. Target cohorts: eu-west. Step 1 -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks: p50/p95/error-rate/latency-spike-detect.

vikram: tagging perf: watch p95 and p99. If p95 > 200ms above baseline for 2 consecutive mins or errors > 0.8% we rollback. Can we pin session affinity for the green pool? Need stickiness for long requests.

tom_k: Ops note — we have a DB maintenance job ending 23:10 UTC. I'd prefer first step at 23:20 so background load subsides. @sara.h can you shift start +20m?

sara.h: ok moved initial trigger to 23:20. Will annotate release notes. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: start=1712005200 (23:20 UTC). Step timeline: 5m probe, then increase if no alerts. Commands: `rbctl router set-weight router-service green 5 --cohort eu-west`

elaine_ops: Also add a soft circuit-breaker policy: max inflight per route = 120, and fallback-policy=route-to-blue if latency spike.

oncall_jp: FYI — I've enabled extra tracing and extended histogram retention for the window. If we see >10% 5xx we pause rollout and notify.

vikram: Agree on rollout gates. Confirming rollback play: deploy-bot should run `rbctl router swap green -> blue rollback` and scale down green behind a drain period of 90s.

sara.h: Confirmed. Post-cutover checklist: 1) verify p95 within 10% baseline for 15m, 2) check cost anomalies, 3) ship release note update. If any gate fails we abort to blue.

tom_k: I'm on standby for rollback window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled and pinned. Annotations: change-window=eu-west-midnight, starts=1712005200, owner=sara.h

sara.h: Starting 23:20 — I'll post periodic check-ins. Ping me with @sara.h for immediate responses.
